svg.text: SERIES 1 • CARD 09 OF 10 • DOMAIN: 4-REGISTER RPN COMPUTING & EXPRESSION TREES • HARDWARE TACTILE KEYS • DUAL LED BAR GRAPH STACK
LESSON GUIDE: 4-REGISTER RPN STACK & EXPRESSION TREES
Grades 8–16 STEM, Physics & Engineering • Hands-On Classroom & Home STEM Studio Series

text.tspan: Where does the first number wait
safely on the stack while you are
entering the second number?
Power on the SC-32. Key: 3 [ENTER] 4 [ENTER].
Stack state: Register Y holds 3.0000; Register X holds 4.0000.
In RPN, numbers always enter before operators!
Press [↰] [x²] on 4: Register X becomes 16.0000.
Press swap [x⇄y]: Register X becomes 3.0000; Y holds 16.0000.
Press [↰] [x²] on 3: Register X becomes 9.0000.
Stack now holds Y = 16.0000 and X = 9.0000.
3. ADD SQUARES: Press [+]. The stack drops: 16.0000 + 9.0000 = 25.0000 in X!
4. SQUARE ROOT: Press [√x]. Result: 5.0000!
Combined Keystrokes: 3 [↰] [x²] 4 [↰] [x²] [+] [√x] → 5.

g.text: CORE PRINCIPLE: THE FREEDOM FROM PARENTHESES

text.tspan: Evaluating √(3² + 4²) in traditional algebraic mode requires nested parentheses. In RPN,
you calculate from the inside out, exactly as you think! Intermediate numbers sit patiently
on the stack until an operator consumes them. Zero parentheses, zero syntax errors!

g.text: ★ EXTENSION INVESTIGATION: KINETIC ENERGY: E = ½ m v²

text.tspan: Calculate kinetic energy for mass m=12 and velocity v=5: 0.5 [ENTER] 12 [×] 5 [↰] [x²] [×] →
150.0000! Zero parentheses! (Scan QR for 3D animated solution!)
